esp32_part: I2S MEMS mic, such as INMP441
limits: 85 dBA and 3 dB exchange are NIOSH; 30 days is a placeholder; the mic needs testing against a Type 2 meter

calculation: SED per hour = UV index x 0.9
trigger: 30 days with peak UV index of 8 or more, and 5+ years outdoors
limits: UV index is modelled in this dataset; salt-pan reflection is not included; sensor has vendor accuracy only

calculation: Colour match to a validated urine chart
trigger: Score of 5 or more on a hot day, twice in 7 days
action: Water and rest advice; creatinine and urine test if a doctor agrees
limits: Chart is validated in a cup; the sensor is not validated; vitamins and medicines can change colour

esp32_part: QR or RFID check-in at the node
calculation: Check-in to check-out, summed by week
trigger: 55+ hours for 4 weeks in a row
action: Blood pressure check and supervisor review
limits: 55 hours comes from WHO/ILO work; 4 weeks is a placeholder; needs worker safeguards

calculation: 55+ hours and 3+ hot days in a week
linked_condition: Heat illness and heart and stroke risk
limits: Team's own idea; no study tests this combination
